final: WITH step1 AS (SELECT p.SEX, AVG(CASE WHEN l.CPK IS NOT NULL AND l.GPT IS NOT NULL AND l.GPT != 0 THEN CAST(l.CPK AS REAL) / l.GPT ELSE NULL END) as ratio FROM Laboratory l JOIN Patient p ON l.ID = p.ID WHERE p.SEX IS NOT NULL AND p.SEX != '' GROUP BY p.SEX), step2 AS (SELECT AVG(ratio) as avg_ratio FROM step1), step3 AS (SELECT s1.SEX, s1.ratio, s1.ratio - s2.avg_ratio as diff FROM step1 s1, step2 s2 WHERE s2.avg_ratio IS NOT NULL AND s1.ratio IS NOT NULL AND s1.ratio > s2.avg_ratio), step4 AS (SELECT AVG(ratio) as avg_ratio FROM step3), step5 AS (SELECT s3.SEX, s3.ratio, s3.diff, s3.ratio - s4.avg_ratio as diff2 FROM step3 s3, step4 s4 WHERE s4.avg_ratio IS NOT NULL AND s3.ratio IS NOT NULL AND s3.ratio > s4.avg_ratio) SELECT AVG(ratio) as col1, AVG(diff) as col2, AVG(diff2) as col3 FROM step5
